scope: For any finite dimension, a reversed nonnegative-real affine certificate with all eleven weak rules and an eligible positive offset gap can be normalized: zero initial matrix, unchanged initial offset, one selected output row relocated to any distinguished coordinate, zero output offset, and a selected gap at least one by positive readout scaling. All eleven original weak comparisons are preserved. No upper coefficient bound is imposed or claimed preserved. The normalized unit-gap rules imply Collatz through the retained real certificate theorem. These are conditional theorems, not a witness or a Collatz proof.
